notes.title: New game called BLASK is out!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/987710/BLASK/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451742/ba5e7d0caded1ba9a3bf052fe85863b958be0a7f.png[/img][/url]

BLASK is a puzzle game where you control the environment
in order to hit all the goal markers with lasers.
Each shape acts as a room made of mirrors. By combining 
and rotating each shape, a player can control where the laser beam
points.

Features:
- Unique mechanics where you combine and rotate shapes to control laser beam reflections
- 3 relaxing chillout/lounge tracks
- Each puzzle can be solved in multiple ways
- Over 60 levels

https://store.steampowered.com/app/987710/BLASK/

notes.title: Rosette and Words update 1.55 is live
notes.content:
New update of the game is live! 

I have added redundancy and backup to the save files. 

When main save file is broken game will try to load backup file.

When also backup save fails it is possible to retrieve older saves which are located in the same directory as main save. You have to replace save.dat file with corresponding backup file which is in the format save_<date>.dat

All saves can be located in the following directory:
%localappdata%/Rosette_and_Words/

I hope it will improve overall experience of the game.
Thank you for feedback and support!
